caption:
You quit it. Why’s it back? (1 Timothy 6:11)

“Flee these things” comes bound to “follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.” Pull the weeds and leave the soil bare, and they spring up again. The emptied place must be filled.

“Follow after” means to chase hard — these are seized, not waited for. And all six are the character of Christ — the One who gave Himself as a ransom for all (2:6). To pursue them is to run toward Him.
